request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --single

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: The request changes list's default to hide completed todos. The old assertion that list(todos) shows completed items now describes the old default, so I changed it to expect only open items. I added an includeDone: true assertion that shows everything, kept the includeDone: false assertion, and renamed the test to match.
